interpretation: All nominal bootstrap intervals are exploratory, including intervals that exclude zero. The source revision changes interpretation and presentation; these market outputs retain their original run identity.

checks.scope: Existing repository tests and synthetic notebook cases; no market replay, validation or final-test evaluation.

publication_exclusions: Instructor price rows and source archives
Private price databases and trade/cash ledgers
Private paths, credentials and sharing links
Historical HTML and conclusions with pre-amendment interpretation
